intended_object: According to its docstring, this is a typeclass wrapper around a property of objects: `P.Is X` holds exactly when `P X` holds. Its purpose is to let typeclass inference find the fact that `X` satisfies `P`.
explanation: The class is a single-field `Prop` structure holding `P X`. The `@[mk_iff]` attribute generates the lemma `P.Is X ↔ P X`. This is an implementation device: it repackages a predicate so that instance search can use it. It adds no mathematical content beyond `P X`, so there is no literature object to compare it against. Viewed as a wrapper, it is correct. The definition places no extra requirement on `C` beyond a `CategoryStruct`.
